summary: Completed the first scenario-complete Ginkgo Bioworks security review using current SEC primary evidence and the canonical 2026-08-04 MACD crossover. First-quarter continuing revenue fell 49% to USD 19.5 million, continuing operations used USD 46.4 million of operating cash, and dilution continued, while USD 373.5 million of cash and marketable securities provides near-term runway. The deterministic assessment recorded Sell, Avoid, 52 quality, medium confidence, and USD 3.33/USD 7.57/USD 16.47 bear/base/bull fair values with USD 8.078 probability-weighted value against USD 9.37. Allocation remains ineligible; no strategy, signal, paper order, issue, or follow-up operation was created.

evidence.claim: The first-quarter SEC filing reported continuing-operations revenue of USD 19.474 million, continuing-operations net loss of USD 76.059 million, continuing-operations operating cash use of USD 46.433 million, stock compensation of USD 15.853 million, and cash plus marketable securities of USD 373.456 million at March 31, 2026; 65,324,491 common shares across classes were outstanding on April 30.

The SEC-filed issuer release reported a 49% year-over-year revenue decline to about USD 19 million, negative USD 42 million adjusted EBITDA, completion of the Biosecurity divestiture, USD 373 million of cash and marketable securities, and reaffirmed USD 125-150 million full-year 2026 cash burn while presenting autonomous laboratories as the refocused strategy.

The canonical alert measured a 0.32% adjusted-close rise from 2026-07-07 through 2026-08-04 to USD 9.37 and a bullish MACD crossover with strength 0.5060; RSI was 60.35 and volume was not anomalous. No current issuer filing explained the late-period rise before the scheduled Q2 update, so the review classified it as improving momentum and timing noise rather than a paper-buy signal.

Deterministic assessment version 2 derived USD 8.078 probability-weighted fair value, -13.7887% expected return, -10.3415% confidence-adjusted expected return, USD 6.056 buy-below price, -23.7781% margin of safety, Sell canonical rating, Avoid portfolio action, Watch conviction tier, 52 quality, and allocation ineligibility with complete threshold-frontier reasons.
